paragraphs: By way of introduction, my name is Joshua Chappell. My intent is to apply for the Video Content Producer position at Zillow. I feel I have a lot of immediate value I can bring to your organization.

Your posting asks for someone to help build the engine behind StudioZ's growing video operation. I have run my own production company for seven years. At Lightbox Digital I take each project from intake through delivery. I delivered 98% of projects on time and 92% within budget, commanding crews of 5-20 people per project. I maintained an organized library of video assets in Frame.io and Dropbox, reducing search and retrieval time by over 50%, and I crafted storyboards that slashed back-and-forth communication by over 50%. At Charter One I built content workflows with Claude agentic coding that cut production times in half.

You would get a producer who has worked across the video lifecycle, on set and in post. At Grand Canyon Education I delivered 200+ videos over two years reaching millions on TV, paid social, and organic channels, and I crystallized scope of work across departments with competing interests. Real estate is familiar ground: I filmed model home videos for Blandford Homes and photographed homes for realtors. I have published to YouTube as a creator: I reached over a million people on YouTube teaching post production techniques.
Thank you for taking the time out of your busy day to read my letter. I look forward to the opportunity of doing an interview with you.
